layout.title: Governed KPI Dictionary
layout.content:
### Meridian Direct - Governed Business Metric Definitions
- **Total Net Sales**: Sum of net revenue ($) across completed catalog sales orders.
- **Return Rate**: Strict ratio of total returned amount over total sales amount (`sum(returned_amount) / sum(net_sales_amount)`).
- **Profit Margin**: Ratio of net profit to net sales (`sum(cs_net_profit) / sum(net_sales_amount)`). Masked for non-PII readers.
- **On-Time Shipping %**: Proportion of order shipments dispatched within SLA duration.
- **Items per Order**: Average basket depth (`sum(quantity) / count(distinct order_number)`).
